title: Stephen Braude's First Person Plural on multiple personality as possession

tellings.quote: Um Steve Browy touched on these in his first book, First Person Plural, which included a chapter about how uh there were cases of multiple personality disorder

plain: Stephen Braude, a philosopher at the University of Maryland, Baltimore, wrote a book called First Person Plural that includes a chapter on cases of multiple personality disorder, which the philosopher Jason Jorjani connects to possession. Jorjani mentions it to Michels as Braude's first book, without quoting it. He brings it up because he takes it to suggest that some split personalities might be outside minds taking hold of a person.
